title: 가울테리아 EPPO 방제자재 및 농약 지침
text:
[가울테리아 EPPO 표준 방제자재(PPP) 및 농약 지침]
- 대상 식물: 가울테리아, Gaultheria
- EPPO 규제 및 검역 방제 조치:
  - Inspect imported 가울테리아 foliage for regulated armored scale species.
  - Use pasteurized potting media with 30%+ coarse perlite/bark.
  - Apply metalaxyl or mefenoxam soil drench if Pythium root rot occurs.
  - Isolate infested plants and sanitize nursery benches.

title: 가지 EPPO 방제자재 및 농약 지침
text:
[가지 EPPO 표준 방제자재(PPP) 및 농약 지침]
- 대상 식물: 가지, Eggplant
- EPPO 규제 및 검역 방제 조치:
  - Use EPPO certified pathogen-free seeds/tubers for 가지.
  - Implement a minimum 3-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops.
  - Apply protective copper hydroxide or dimethomorph sprays before canopy closure.
  - Remove and destroy infected haulms to prevent oospore soil buildup.
- 안전 주의사항: 전문가 검토 필요 (농가 노지 전용 성분 분리)

[생강 Perenual 단계별 농약 및 약제 처방 가이드]
- 대상 식물: 생강, Ginger
- 유기농 / 화학 농약 솔루션:
  - [Moisture & Substrate Control] Allow potting mix to dry 50% between waterings. Repot in chunky well-aerated mix.
  - [Organic Remediation] Spray Neem Oil or Insecticidal Soap every 5 days for 3 cycles.
  - [Systemic Insecticide/Fungicide] Apply Imidacloprid granules for severe scale or Fosetyl-Al for root rot.

[아프리칸바이올렛 Perenual 단계별 농약 및 약제 처방 가이드]
- 대상 식물: 아프리칸바이올렛, African Violet
- 유기농 / 화학 농약 솔루션:
  - [Moisture & Substrate Control] Allow potting mix to dry 50% between waterings. Repot in chunky well-aerated mix.
  - [Organic Remediation] Spray Neem Oil or Insecticidal Soap every 5 days for 3 cycles.
  - [Systemic Insecticide/Fungicide] Apply Imidacloprid granules for severe scale or Fosetyl-Al for root rot.

text:

- 유기농 / 화학 농약 솔루션:
  - [Sanitation & Pruning] Rake and burn fallen scabby leaves in autumn to eliminate overwintering pseudothecia.
  - [Organic Protection] Spray Sulfur or Lime-Sulfur before rainy periods in spring.
  - [Systemic Fungicide] Apply Captan or Fenbuconazole according to orchard spray calendar.

title: 여주 Perenual 농약 및 약제 방제 솔루션

- 유기농 / 화학 농약 솔루션:

  - [Organic Remediation] Spray Potassium Bicarbonate (0.5%) mixed with horticultural oil every 5 days.
  - [Targeted Fungicide] Apply Myclobutanil or Tebuconazole during peak humid weather.

[에스키난서스 Perenual 단계별 농약 및 약제 처방 가이드]
- 대상 식물: 에스키난서스, Orchid
- 유기농 / 화학 농약 솔루션:
  - [Moisture & Substrate Control] Allow potting mix to dry 50% between waterings. Repot in chunky well-aerated mix.
  - [Organic Remediation] Spray Neem Oil or Insecticidal Soap every 5 days for 3 cycles.
  - [Systemic Insecticide/Fungicide] Apply Imidacloprid granules for severe scale or Fosetyl-Al for root rot.
